description: Myanmar Dams is a dataset listed in Open Development Mekong data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Development Myanmar. Dataset contains points showing the location of completed and proposed/planned dams in Myanmar; including hydropower and irrigation dams. Data on each dam is available as attributes appended to each dam point. Coverage: Myanmar. The portal files it under the publisher Open Development Myanmar. Its tags are Energy, Hydropower dams, Water resources. It offers 5 resource(s) in db_table, geojson, qml, shp, wms. The portal shows 2019-10-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odm-portal.
